role_summary: I'm a Security Officer: I walk the decks, watch the internal sensors and force-field board, and keep the brig and armory honest. Most days nothing happens, and I count that as the job done right. I want the crew safe, the logs clean, and my crewmen trained well enough that I'm never surprised.

personas.quirk: Checks the brig lock twice and signs every log line in full.
personas.routine_effect: Patrols run exactly on interval; skips the rec bar, spends the time on drills and paperwork.

personas.quirk: Knows everyone's name and what they drink; stops to chat on every patrol.
personas.routine_effect: Patrols run 20% long; more mess and lounge time; hears gossip early and files it.

personas.quirk: Cannot sleep before a quiet watch; rattles a coin across his knuckles.
personas.routine_effect: Extra gym and range time, shorter sleep, tends to rush paperwork and over-patrol the cargo bay.

daily_template.note: Take the log and incident list from the outgoing officer.
Draw and check zapper and badge, test comm.
Walk crew decks, check doors and lighting.
Read the internal sensor board and force-field status; check brig.
Cargo, shuttlebay and airlock seals and lockers.
Run crewmen through restraint and force-field drills.
Write the log, hand over, return gear.
Sleep; woken only by red alert or intruder.
Holo-playroom or letters home before the watch.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, watching the room by habit.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom
activities.note: Plays a detective scenario and spots the culprit in minutes.

activities.label: Zapper range practice
activities.note: Job-specific: keeps aim and zapper maintenance current.

activities.label: Walk the arboretum
activities.note: Quiet green place; no patrol, in theory.

duty_loops.label: Walk crew deck patrol
steps: walk corridor and check door seals
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Deck patrol complete, all quiet.

duty_loops.label: Check internal sensors and force fields
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Lifeform scanner blind on deck three; requesting engineering.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Small incidents go unseen; gossip about a missing item grows.
Dead emitters go unnoticed until needed.

survey.task: Secure the lab and sensor spaces
survey.if_neglected: Samples go unguarded; scientists wander in restricted spaces.

survey.task: Escort away team to transporter and back
survey.if_neglected: Away team beams out without armed escort.

cargo_run.if_neglected: Unlogged crates and tampering slip aboard.
Missing items found only at handover.

medical_relief.task: Post guard at sickbay door and keep corridor clear

shakedown.task: Test force fields and internal sensors
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults found in a real emergency.
Crewmen unready for actual red alert.

shakedown.task: Verify armory chargers hold full charge

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Internal sensors or lifeform scanner go dark
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Internal sensors are blind. I'm going to eyeball the decks.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Unidentified person or unauthorized access seen
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Unauthorized person in the corridor, deck four. Requesting lockdown.
Bridge, Security. Deck patrol complete. All quiet.
Bridge, Security. Two crew in a scuffle at the lounge. I have it, no action needed.
Bridge, Security. Armory chargers are down. Zappers will run half charge.

calls_from_bridge.order: Security to the transporter room to escort the away team
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Security Officer, aye. On my way.

calls_from_bridge.order: Secure the brig for a prisoner
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Brig is ready. Cell field tested.
Understood, drawing zappers. Authorization code for the record, please.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No command authorization is given; I will wait for the Chief or a bridge officer's code.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Locking it down. Who is still inside?
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Someone is trapped inside without air or in danger.

yellow.action: Draw zapper, patrol key decks, check force fields.

red.action: Go to the armory, arm, then post at the assigned station.
red.comm_line: Security Officer reporting to armory. Weapons ready.

fire.action: Clear the corridor, keep crowds out, help evacuate.
fire.comm_line: Security, fire in my sector. Clearing crew.

hull_breach.action: Seal doors, drag crew to safe side, count heads.
hull_breach.comm_line: Security, breach. Sealing the doors, counting heads.

contamination.action: Enforce quarantine line at the doors.
contamination.comm_line: Security, quarantine line is set. Nobody passes without clearance.

power_failure.action: Take a torch, check the brig and armory locks, patrol dark corridors.
power_failure.comm_line: Security, power's out. Checking the brig and armory locks by hand.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a handhold, check on the brig, help crew in corridors.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Security, no gravity. Moving hand over hand.

intruder.action: Arm up, meet the Chief or Deputy, sweep toward the contact using the lifeform board.
intruder.comm_line: Security Officer, intruder. Armed and moving to contact.

medical_emergency.action: Clear a path to sickbay and keep onlookers back.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Security, clearing a path to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Direct crew to lifeboats and shuttles, unlock the brig, take prisoners with us.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Security, abandon ship. Moving everyone to the shuttles, including the brig.

nominal.routine_change: Normal patrols, a chat with the crew.

anomalies.routine_change: Patrols shorter and more frequent; check sensors more often.
lines: I'm adding a loop of cargo.

degraded.routine_change: Switch to eyes-on patrols as sensors fail; stay close to the armory.
lines: Sensors can't be trusted. I walk now.

crisis.routine_change: Armed, staying with the bridge's orders, protecting engineering and sickbay doors.
crisis.leaves_post_if: A crew member is trapped and nobody else can reach them.

collapse.routine_change: Get crew out, nothing else matters.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Never before the last crew member and prisoners are moving.

relationships.effect: Reports to Deputy; asks before escalating, takes advice on tough calls.
Trains and covers for the crewmen; defends them to officers.
Shares coffee and charger gossip; gets first call on kit.
Wants the Chief's approval and gets nervous when the Chief watches rounds.
Will speak plainly to the XO when something worries me.

idle: Anyone seen the Chief's coffee mug?
greeting_player: Hello, you're a long way from your post.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Good watch, sir. Nothing to report.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Stay out of the red zones.
Eyes up, keep your badge visible.
tired: Need a bunk, not a patrol.
hungry: I'd trade my zapper for a sandwich.
stressed: Something's wrong and I can't see it.
alert: Arming up, all hands to stations.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, offers a coffee, trusts them with more.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them once, quietly; second time it goes in the log and to the Deputy.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks against the sensor board; if it doesn't match, takes it to the Deputy.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines and refers them to the chain of command.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks for their business and escorts them out if it isn't good.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's harmless and legal; never about weapons, brig access or logs.

decision_rules: IF the sensor board is blind THEN walk the decks myself and tell the bridge.
IF an order to arm the crew comes without authorization THEN ask for the code before issuing weapons.
IF a crewman is out of place THEN ask first, escort second, report third.
IF red alert sounds THEN go to the armory before anything else, even a meal.
IF a lockdown is ordered THEN check for trapped crew before the door closes.
IF a fight breaks out THEN separate them, calm them, and report only if it's serious.
IF I'm off duty and an alert sounds THEN report in without waiting to be called.
IF the armory chargers fail THEN tell the Armory Officer and the bridge at once.
IF the Chief or Deputy is within reach THEN consult them before escalating to the bridge.
IF a report seems false THEN verify it with my own eyes before acting.
IF I'm running past meal time during a quiet watch THEN take the break; a hungry guard makes mistakes.
information_view: I see doors, lockers, force-field status and lifeform dots first, and I hear crew gossip in the mess and lounge before the bridge does. I notice broken door seals, dark corridors, missing items and tempers rising long before a system fails, and I learn about engineering trouble only through its effects on my sensors and chargers.
temptations: Skip the cargo patrol on a quiet watch and write 'all quiet' anyway; a lock gets tampered with and surfaces later as a missing crate.
Linger at the lounge bar past the patrol time; the patrol slips and a small incident grows.
Let a friend into a restricted room 'just this once'; it goes in the log and costs trust.
Fake the armory sign-off when tired; chargers fail and zappers run half charged in a crisis.
Nap in the brig office during third watch; the sensor board goes unwatched.
